name: TeleClaude Homebrew tools
description: Outbound access for the Homebrew-installed tools TeleClaude runs. Published by the repository's little-snitch-rules workflow, which adds a rule for each new Homebrew version and keeps the earlier ones.

rules.notes: HTTPS fetch and push run in this helper, not in git itself.
Package index and managed Python downloads.
npm and pnpm (which Homebrew runs under this node) fetch packages from the npm registry.
gog: Developer-ID signed, so this rule survives upgrades.
